svg.title: Expanded Step Functions workflow and ECS task mapping
svg.desc: Exact states from pipeline-ecs.yaml. Four sequential ECS runTask.sync invocations reuse one registered task-definition revision: PrepareData mode prepare on FARGATE; Tune mode tune and Train default mode train on FARGATE_SPOT; EvaluateAndPublish mode evaluate_publish on FARGATE. Preparation can be skipped. SNS approval and notifications do not launch ECS tasks. Error routes are summarized separately.

g.text: Step Functions: states and ECS task mapping
Same ARN for all four invocations
Task Catch, non-zero exit, or rejected / timed-out approval
Each ECS step starts a new task using the same revision and trainer container.
Official AWS Architecture Icons, July 2026. Source: pipeline-ecs.yaml + development parameters.
